pages.text: Rockets and space ships are the end of the road in Create Galore. You can't just build one whenever you like: every way off the planet needs a $(item)Stellar Core$(), and a core needs one prize from each big branch of the world.

pages.title: The six prizes
pages.text: $(li)$(l:stars/abyss)Immortal Embryo$(/l): the deep sea$(li)$(l:stars/twilight)4 Fiery Ingots$(/l): Twilight Forest$(li)$(l:stars/aether)4 Enchanted Gravitite$(/l): the Aether$(li)$(l:stars/nether)Nether Star$(/l): the Nether$(li)$(l:stars/end)4 Dragonskin$(/l): the End$(li)$(l:stars/industry)2 Circuit Boards$(/l): heavy industry

pages.title: What it gates
pages.text: All three ways up take a core:$(li)the Northstar $(item)Rocket Station$()$(li)the $(item)Dimensional Drive$()$(li)the $(item)Stellar Navigator$()

pages.title: One per vehicle
pages.text: Each of those blocks is placed once and reused trip after trip, so one core per vehicle is enough. Friends can share one rocket.

pages.title: No dead ends
pages.text: Nothing on this list comes from space, and nothing on Earth needs a space item to work. Every prize can be found again: bosses respawn or have more lairs, and ores keep generating further out. Titanium is made on Earth by sequenced assembly.

pages.title: Your checklist
pages.text: Open Advancements and find the $(thing)Road to the Stars$() tab. It ticks off each prize as you pick it up, then the core, then your first trip off Earth.$(br2)The bosses can all be beaten with Create builds: see $(l:stars/machine_fights)Fighting with Machines$(/l).
